pi_model_definition.$comment: Isolated Pi provider/model definition for the repaired GLM-5.3 experiment (P03/P10). Copied into PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/models.json for the V arm; baseUrl is replaced with the gateway's actual listen address at deploy time. compat overrides replicate the z.ai request format through the gateway (Pi 0.85.1: thinkingFormat zai sends thinking:{type:enabled,clear_thinking:false}; supportsReasoningEffort adds reasoning_effort; maxTokensField max_tokens). samplingParams pins temperature 0.6 with NO top_p. maxTokens 32768 matches the frozen per-request output cap; contextWindow 262144 is the client ceiling.

primary_metric: official matcher strict micro F3 within each trial, mean over three trials

thresholds.positive_rule: (F3_H >= F3_V + 5 OR (R_H >= R_V - 0.05 AND P_H >= P_V + 0.10)) AND fewer H FPs on >=4/6 repos in >=2/3 trials (strictly fewer; ties never count)
thresholds.precedence: invalid/incomplete first, then positive rule, then does-not-meet

secondary_analyses: report-policy ablations separated from the decision
greedy-matcher order sensitivity (fixed seed, labeled secondary)

failure_scoring.eligible_retained_output_after_failure: A valid eligible committed export from a failed attempt (timeout-recovered checkpoint/snapshot, degraded stage health, nonzero exit) is SCORED and reported with its actual degraded status — never silently upgraded to a clean completion. CORRECTION of the v5 discrepancy: the v5 protocol text said post-inference output failure receives empty predictions while the v5 report scored both failed-output artifacts; v6 states the actual policy explicitly. The v5 empty-output sensitivity analysis in RESULTS-HARNESS-VS-PI-RELIABILITY-2026-09-23.md is retained as history.
failure_scoring.no_eligible_output_after_inference: Inference-bearing attempt with NO eligible committed output: empty predictions (scored positives FN, decoys TN); operational failure; never labeled agent-authored.
failure_scoring.committed_evidence_corrupt_or_mismatched: Integrity failure; no headline (never silently empty predictions).

admission.$comment: v6 admission (plan step D): file references resolved and verified at freeze — contents parsed, gates all passed, image_id and runtime_tree_sha256 bound to the frozen runtime. Fill with the relfix evidence paths at scored time; a bare hash string is not admissible.

deadline_policy.eligible_output: operator-owned pre-deadline captures only (hash+schema re-validated at selection); agent-writable snapshot metadata is never trusted
deadline_policy.clean_completion_requires: exit 0 AND complete clean terminal stage health for the H arm (missing health evidence is not clean)
